! --- plain ||domain^ blocks (the only class today's lite parser keeps) ---
||ads.example.com^
||tracker.example.net^
||analytics.example.org^
||pixel.adserver.example^

||doubleclick-proxy.example^
||telemetry.vendor.example^
||a.collect.example^
||b.collect.example^
||c.collect.example^

! --- ||domain^ with DNS-relevant options (in scope; precedence-bearing) ---
||promo.example.com^$important
||hard.block.example^$important
||rewrite.example^$dnsrewrite=0.0.0.0
||gone.example^$badfilter
||stale.block.example^$badfilter
!
! --- @@ exceptions (dropped today -> the over-blocking the ADR fixes) ---
@@||cdn.example.com^
@@||static.example.net^
@@||login.example.org^
@@||api.vendor.example^
@@||safe.collect.example^
@@||allow.example^$important

0.0.0.0 tracker.hostsfmt.example
0.0.0.0 ads.hostsfmt.example

0.0.0.0 beacon.hostsfmt.example
!
! --- bare plain domains ---
plain.bad.example
another.plain.example
third.plain.example

! --- IP-anchored / hosts-IP (PHP firewall path; Python returns None) ---
||203.0.113.7^
||198.51.100.42^
0.0.0.0 203.0.113.99
!
! --- regex rules: see regex_reducible.txt / regex_irreducible.txt for the bulk;
!     a couple inline here so the sample alone exercises the dispatch ---
/^ads\d*\.tracker\.example$/
@@/safe-cdn\.example/
!
! --- element-hiding / cosmetic (DNS-only scope SKIPS all of these) ---
example.com##.ad-banner
example.com##div[class^="sponsor"]
##.global-ad
example.net#@#.whitelisted-ad
example.org#?#div:has(> .ad)
!
! --- path / URL rules (not a whole-domain DNS decision -> SKIP) ---
||example.com/ads/*
||cdn.example.net/track.js
/banners/*.gif
||shop.example^/affiliate?id=
!
! --- page-context $options (not DNS-meaningful -> SKIP) ---
||widget.example^$third-party
||script.example^$script
||img.example^$image,third-party
||frame.example^$subdocument
||csp.example^$csp=script-src
||domspecific.example^$domain=foo.com
! underscore label (#723): DNS-legal, accepted by production and the oracle alike
||_dmarc.underscore-corpus.com^
